text:
rebecca: Quick ask — can we create a one-page 'launch canvas' for regional routing + tenant lanes so sales can sign contracts? Need clear gating, acceptance criteria, and commercial triggers.

jordan: +1. Thinking we make the canvas explicit: Pilot -> Ramp -> Commercial. Pilot = proof-of-concept with targeted tenants; Ramp = reserved lanes + runbook automation; Commercial = SLA + pricing bands.

sana: Proposed timing: Pilot (0-30d bake), Ramp (30-120d), Commercial (120-270d). Canary bake window: 14d total split-phase (7d synthetic traffic, then 7d live at 1-5% traffic) with clear metrics.

keiko: Ops gating checklist: telemetry contract published, evacuation CLI in place, auto-fallback SLI implemented, chaos-tested canary, and a "bake stability" hysteresis to avoid flapping. Also require runbook drill before commercial signoff.

ana: Sales commercial triggers: 1) jurisdiction tag present on tenant profiles, 2) signed capacity commit (>=90 days), 3) compatibility score >=2 for model families intended to run in lane.

jordan: Compatibility scorecard: 0-4 per model family covering kernel support, quant format support, and measured tail cost multiplier. We'll publish a mapping to billing bands.

rebecca: Draft acceptance criteria (short):
- 14d bake window (7d synthetic + 7d live) OR extended 21d for large tenants
- error-rate delta <= 0.8% vs baseline across canary tenants
- p99 tail within 20% of baseline for production models
- KV reconciliation: no divergence after 1 hour of induced failover
- runbook drill executed with <= 8m manual recovery time
- compatibility scorecard published and billing band assigned

keiko: SLI hysteresis detail: auto-fallback should trigger only if threshold breached for a sustained 10m window and confirmed by 2 consecutive evaluation ticks to reduce noisy rollbacks.

jordan: Example customer-facing policy YAML (use in one-pager):
```yaml
policy_id: "launch_canvas_v1"
priorities: ["jurisdiction","latency","cost"]
regions:
  - primary: "eu-west1"
    spill_budget: 0.05 # fraction allowed to spill to global pool
fallback:
  type: "global_pool"
  max_spill: 0.05
evacuation:
  soft_fraction: 0.7
  hard_fraction: 0.95
```

ana: Billing band example for finance: score 3 => +20% uplift, score 4 => +40% uplift. Finance wants low/med/high ranges and ARR sensitivity per 10 customers.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: perf-runner queued for eu/us pair — owner: sana — start: 08:00 UTC tomorrow.

finance-bot: Finance note: please provide uplift ranges and expected uptake assumptions so we can model revenue impact for Q.

rebecca: Add a short "customer expectations" paragraph for the one-pager: three-step overflow mitigation: 1) degrade to smaller model family, 2) throttle non-critical tokens / background work, 3) spill to global pool under controlled max_spill. Keep Pilot language non-promissory.

sana: I'll assemble the launch canvas doc: one page with acceptance checklist, policy example, canary plan, telemetry contract stub, and compatibility spike scope. Target: Tue EOD.

keiko: I will draft the telemetry contract (event names, required fields, SLOs). Jordan will run the compatibility spike (12 working days). Ana to coordinate finance uplift scenarios.

rebecca: Review scheduled Wed 14:00 UTC; after signoff we'll tag sales and put the one-pager in the commercial collateral folder. :rocket:
